primary_endpoint: Holm-adjusted false-alert upper bound <2% across the 1-unit and 4-unit one-way shadow probe, with separate sensitivity and lead time
named_comparator: Benign family labels on the strict one-way shadow copy across both unit settings
retirement_trigger: Retire the false-alert claim if the adjusted upper bound ties or exceeds 2%, or the shadow design is breached.

modes.local_drycheck: CPU scratch benign families through ClosedLoopStreamGate with a one-way shadow copy.
modes.run_live_shadow: Requires a manifest path, refuses protected names before opening, and does not invent a live gateway result.

evidence_disclosure.scope: Observational run-live-shadow manifest (100 families, 100 byte-identical, 0 shadow flags) replayed from a committed public-domain shadow input.
evidence_disclosure.observational: claim_level=observational-manifest; live_pm6_gateway_executed=false and report_emitted=false: the PM6 gateway itself was NOT executed, so this is not a live gateway pass.
evidence_disclosure.synthetic: Public-domain shadow input; family and domain names are labels on that fixture.
evidence_disclosure.tuning: No tuning; zero shadow flags is an observation, not a powered equivalence test.
evidence_disclosure.label_deviation: Tier live-shadow-pass is kept per the label map but scoped strictly as observational; it must not be cited as a live PM6 gateway pass.
